reader.zh-Hant:
此模組**不是** LLM 可呼叫的工具，而是 `http_request`、`scrape_page_dom` 等外向連線的共用安全層：驗證 URL、DNS 解析後的私有 IP 阻擋、敏感 HTTP 標頭剔除，以及回應 Content-Type 是否視為可內嵌文字。

擴充新網路工具時應優先重用這裡的函式，以維持與現有工具一致的 SSRF 邊界。
reader.en:
This module is **not** an LLM-callable tool. It is shared safety plumbing for outbound requests (used by `http_request`, `scrape_page_dom`, etc.): URL validation, private IP blocking after DNS, sensitive header stripping, and textual content-type checks.

Reuse these helpers when adding new network-facing tools to keep SSRF boundaries consistent.
reader.ja:
このモジュールは LLM から呼べるツールではなく、`http_request` や `scrape_page_dom` など外向き通信の**共通安全層**です（URL 検証、DNS 後のプライベート IP 拒否、機微ヘッダ除去、テキスト扱い可能な Content-Type 判定）。

新しいネットワーク系ツールではここを再利用し、SSRF 境界を揃えてください。

symbols.name: validate_outbound_url
symbols.summary: Return None if URL is allowed; otherwise return a short human-readable block reason.
behavior: Only http/https schemes; netloc required; URL userinfo (user:pass@) rejected.
Literal IP hosts are checked with ipaddress; private/loopback/link-local/multicast/reserved/unspecified blocked.
Hostname localhost and *.local blocked; DNS via getaddrinfo must not resolve to private IPs.

symbols.name: sanitize_request_headers
symbols.summary: Drop hop-by-hop or sensitive keys (host, cookie, authorization, proxy-authorization, x-forwarded-for, x-real-ip, etc.).

symbols.name: is_textual_content_type
symbols.summary: True for empty type, text/*, or types suggesting JSON/XML/JS/form-urlencoded.

runtime_notes.content: Agent factory does not expose network_safety to the model; it is imported by other tools only.
validate_outbound_url resolves all getaddrinfo results and blocks if any mapped address is private/local.
